header.running_head: Relationships between Men, Women and Children

blocks.text: I then said to Sauda bint Zam'ah (RA), 'Rasulullaah ﷺ will soon be coming to you. When he gets close to you, ask him whether he ate Maghaafeer. When he tells you that he has not eaten any, ask him what it is then that you can smell. He will then tell you that Hafsah gave him a drink of honey, to which you should say, 'The bee must have sucked nectar from the Urfut palm (the palm containing Maghaafeer).' I will also say the same thing and you O Safiyya should also do likewise."

Hadhrat Sauda (RA) later reported (to Hadhrat Aa'isha (RA)), "By Allaah! Because of my fear for you, I almost called out what you told while Rasulullaah ﷺ was still standing at the door. (Controlling myself however) When he drew closer, I said, 'O Rasulullaah ﷺ! Have you eaten Maghaafeer?' 'No,' he replied. 'Then what is that I smell on you?' I asked. He replied, 'Hafsah gave me a drink of honey.' I then said, 'The bee must have sucked nectar from the Urfut palm.'"

When Rasulullaah ﷺ went to Hadhrat Aa'isha (RA), she also said the same thing and Hadhrat Safiyya (RA) also followed suit. When Rasulullaah ﷺ again went to Hadhrat Hafsah (RA) and she offered him some honey to drink, he declined saying, "I do not need any." "By Allaah!" Hadhrat Sauda (RA) said to Hadhrat Aa'isha (RA), "We have stopped Rasulullaah ﷺ from honey." "Be quiet!" Hadhrat Aa'isha (RA) told her. [^1]
The Incident of Rasulullaah ﷺ when he Intended Divorcing his Wives
Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Abbaas (RA) reports, "I had always been eager to ask Umar (RA) about the two wives of Rasulullaah ﷺ concerning whom Allaah says (in the Qur'aan):

blocks.arabic_text: إِنْ تَتُوبَآ إِلَى اللَّهِ فَقَدْ صَغَتْ قُلُوبُكُمَا
blocks.text: 'If the two of you repent to Allaah, then your hearts have surely turned (turned back towards the best course after straying for a while).'

This (thought) lingered on until the time when Umar (RA) performed Hajj and I performed Hajj with him. We were still travelling when Umar (RA) went off the road (to answer the call the nature). I also veered off taking a jug (of water) along with me. After he had completed, Umar (RA) came to me and I started pouring water into his hands as he made wudhu. 'O Ameerul Mu'mineen!' I said, 'Who were the two wives of Rasulullaah ﷺ concerning whom Allaah says:

blocks.arabic_text: إِنْ تَتُوبَآ إِلَى اللَّهِ فَقَدْ صَغَتْ قُلُوبُكُمَا
blocks.text: 'If the two of you repent to Allaah, then your hearts have surely turned (turned back towards the best course after straying for a while).'?"
